text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: The Japanese Derby is upon us.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
This is our chance to show the<n>spectators, the
younger students, and<n>my future rivals the beauty
of our<n>dream.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
If I'm to realize my ideals, then this is<n>one race I
cannot afford to lose.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
choice_data_list: Just try to keep a clear head.
Just try to keep a clear head.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Haha. I'm an open book to you,<n>aren't I? You're
right, of course—I am<n>getting a little swept up in the
spirit of<n>the race.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
But how else would you have me<n>feel? The crowd
expects the best<n>from me...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
You aspire to the title of Derby<n>Trainer, don't you?
As surely every<n>trainer must.
choice_data_list: All I want is to see you crowned.
All I want is to see you crowned.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
So if I simply race to realize my own<n>ambitions, then
yours will come about<n>naturally.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Well, you need do nothing more than<n>sit back and
watch. The stands are<n>packed with fans who have
come to<n>watch dreams take flight.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Let the Emperor give them one to<n>cheer for.
